description: Development of a hotel (Use Class C1) and refurbishment and alteration of the west of the listed building most recently used as a gymnasium to provide back of house areas for the functioning of the proposed hotel and banqueting venue (Part retrospective)(Application for Listed Building Consent) (associated with planning application ref: 3638/APP/2026/1538).
subdivision_of_building: Whole Former Regal Cinema building excluding the operating snooker hall on the first floor of the High Street frontage
decision_conditions: The works hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.
To comply with Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans, numbers:

and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence, subject to the works proposed under the associated planning permission (LPA ref: 3638/APP/2026/1538) being granted consent.
To ensure the development complies with the provisions Hillingdon Local Plan Parts 1 (November 2012) and 2 (January 2020) and the London Plan (2021).

No development shall take place until details of all materials and finishes to be used for all external surfaces of the building (including window details and finishes) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details should include information relating to make, product/type, colour and photographs/images.
Sample panels of external materials and detailing should be provided on site before commencement of any works.

Thereafter the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and be retained as such, subject to the works proposed under the associated planning permission (LPA ref: 3638/APP/2026/1538) being granted consent.
To safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

No development shall take place until details of the works in relation to the musical instrument lofts display doors (frameless glazing) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and be retained as such, subject to the works proposed under the associated planning permission (LPA ref: 3638/APP/2026/1538) being granted consent.
To safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

No development shall take place until a scheme to protect the fabric of the two music rooms connected to the organ has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include the installation of glass panels with appropriate signage. Thereafter the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and be retained as such, subject to the works proposed under the associated planning permission (LPA ref: 3638/APP/2026/1538) being granted consent.
To safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The decision to GRANT listed building consent has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

On this decision notice policies from the Councils Local Plan: Part 1 - Strategic Policies appear first, then relevant Local Plan Part 2 (2020), then London Plan Policies (2021). Hillingdon's Full Council adopted the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 1 - Strategic Policies on 8 November 2012 and the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 on 16 January 2020.

This Listed Building Consent relates solely to works requiring consent under the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and does not grant planning permission for a hotel or the use of the building as a banqueting hall, or for any use other than the existing lawful use of the premises as a nightclub. Any operational development or material change of use requiring planning permission must not be carried out without first obtaining the requisite permission from the Local Planning Authority. Development undertaken without the benefit of planning permission may constitute a breach of planning control and may result in enforcement action being taken by the Local Planning Authority. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that all necessary consents are obtained before any works commence.

This Listed Building Consent does not authorise the display of advertisements or signs, separate consent for which may be required under the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 1992.
